about: Creality CFS material codes (box.Tn.material_type) mapped to a material family. Only codes proven on a real printer are listed; every other code is reported as unknown. Creality Print does not publish these 6-character codes: its profiles carry 5-character filament_id values (08001 is Ender-PLA in https://github.com/CrealityOfficial/CrealityPrint/blob/6262848e302b8c0d593f2b341cd01310aa2f58a1/resources/profiles/Creality/filament/Ender-PLA%20@Creality%20K2%200.4%20nozzle.json) and it downloads its full material list from Creality's cloud at run time (src/slic3r/GUI/MaterialListDownloader.cpp at the same commit). Creality's firmware reads material_type as 6 characters of the spool's RFID text (https://github.com/CrealityOfficial/Hi_Klipper/blob/646b6aaaa4dc1fe9c4f773f1a425ea4666e5ed9b/klippy/extras/external_material_wrapper.py). See docs/PRINTERS.md, Loaded filament.
